references.text: Joshua is referred to as Moses' servant, the same description used here in Num 11:28
Joshua son of Nun is described as Moses' servant who did not leave the tent, showing his close relationship with Moses
Joshua son of Nun is mentioned as the one standing before Moses and will lead Israel into the land
Joshua son of Nun is appointed by the Lord as Moses' successor

Moses' response to Joshua shows that Moses was not jealous but wanted all the Lord's people to be prophets
